They are captured during it and shipped the same week, while the topic is still warm. Here are the post types that work and the timing rule that decides whether they land. The production team works from a side-stage workstation, layers go live one at a time, and every layer is exercised during dress rehearsal so the actual ceremony runs untouched. Conference media infrastructure: the production stack turning every session into a live audience layer, social content, speaker kits, and a permanent showroom. Comparison May 21, 2026 AI vs. Human Editor at Conferences AI alone is too fast and too brittle. Human editors alone are too slow. The model at conference scale is AI for capture, humans for editorial review. Generic tools fall short for live events. Speaker Kits What every speaker should walk away with, and how fast. 3 articles Q&A Jun 1, 2026 How Fast Should a Speaker Kit Be Delivered? A conference speaker kit should arrive within 60 minutes of the session ending. The 2-to-3-week delivery most vendors quote drains kit value before use. Guide May 25, 2026 What Should Be in a Speaker Kit Eight essentials every conference speaker kit should include, what good looks like for each, and delivery standards that decide whether the kit gets used. Q&A May 21, 2026 What Is a Speaker Kit at a Conference? A speaker kit is a personalized content package for each conference speaker: clips, quote cards, recap article, and a dedicated shareable speaker page. Live Experience The real-time companion attendees use during sessions. 3 articles Q&A Jun 4, 2026 What Does a Conference Live Feed Look Like to Attendees? A conference live feed is the real-time digital companion attendees follow on their phones during sessions, with searchable transcript, auto-generated headlines and quotes, topic navigation, and AI chat grounded in what was just said. At the Atlas Award ceremony at the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, 138 navigation titles let online viewers move through a two-hour broadcast in real time. Q&A Jun 2, 2026 What Are Live Navigation Titles for Events? Live navigation titles are real-time topic markers that let viewers jump to the exact moment they want inside a live broadcast or live conference feed, generated as the session runs instead of added during post-production. Q&A May 29, 2026 Live Captioning for Conferences Live captioning for conferences: real-time speech-to-text on attendee phones and venue screens. Accessibility plus comprehension in noisy rooms. Post-Event Showroom The permanent destination the event leaves behind. 2 articles Comparison May 28, 2026 Conference Showroom vs. YouTube Playlist YouTube hosts the video. A conference showroom is the navigable, searchable, AI-citable destination on top. The playlist alone leaves value on the table. Landing May 21, 2026 What Is a Conference Showroom? A conference showroom is a branded, Netflix-style destination where attendees explore sessions after the event. Organized by topic, speaker, day, and stage. AI Search (AEO) Getting conference content cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. 2 articles Q&A Jun 4, 2026 How Does ChatGPT Decide Which Conferences to Recommend? ChatGPT recommends conferences whose past content is structured, attributed, and published on permanent URLs the model can read. The decision is made on citation signals, not on event reputation. A conference whose past sessions never made it into a citable form does not appear in AI answers, regardless of how prestigious the event is. Q&A May 22, 2026 How Conference Content Gets Cited by AI Search AI search engines cite content with full transcripts, machine-readable structure, stable URLs, and topical authority. The session video alone is not enough.
